material.acceptance_criteria: Either the queue is held in sim state and survives a keyframe resync, or a resynced peer restores the queue; a two-client resync during a shift-queued move leaves both clients issuing the same orders.
material.description: UNVERIFIED LEAD from trav-controls-lua. The shift-queue that controls.lua builds (around line 218) is kept in the Lua mod, not in the sim. A peer that resyncs from a keyframe during a shift-queue would not have the queued orders, so its queue would differ from the one the player sees. Not reproduced yet; the lane marked it as a lead, not a finding.

notes.note: Not reproduced, not fixed. Reproduction needs two live clients in a match (a keyframe resync mid-shift-queue). Live check (browser dispatch 1792862772886-5303-5a481f4722e0f263, session verify-PARSEDV-trav-controls-lua-1, page https://lanmower.github.io/oscraft/js/client/play.html at 1280x720): the lobby joins a room but stays at "loading world assets: still pending after 15 s"; console shows WebSocket wss://relay.damus.io/ handshake 503. A match cannot start, so the in-game witness is blocked by lobby-disabled-when-one-relay-503. Left pending.

drain-controls-shard-2: not reproduced, left pending. The shift queue is controls.lua QUEUE (pack Lua state), and the page exposes no queue state; the only observable is unit positions via oscraft.getState. A two-client keyframe-resync check was not run: the premise that a resynced guest diverges is unverified.

Not driven this run. Live witness blocked: gm browser verb claims the dispatch and never writes its out-file (5 tries, gm-mcp 0.2.302 and 0.2.305, bodies with and without gm_session_id, about:blank included); each holds the state lane until the 600 s watchdog. Clearing action: fix the browser executor in the agentplug runner.
survey-sim-8: same class as new row lua-module-caches-survive-load-state-swap (effects, targeting, upgrades caches also survive load_state/swap_data); a shared reset hook would cover QUEUE too.
drain-ui-panels-9: needs two live clients (browser) to reproduce resync mid-shift-queue; left open.

drain-rust-10 plan (not implemented, not contained): QUEUE (scenarios/moba/controls.lua:218) is Lua-module state and is not in sim save/hash. Fix needs (1) a per-unit order queue in sim (rust/crates/sim, persisted in persist.rs and hashed, so a save-format and hash change for every scenario), (2) natives game.queue_order/queue_clear/queue_pop in mod-host, (3) controls.lua :248-270 and :595-612 moved onto them. Interim shipped by drain-rust-10: host now runs on_state_replaced(state) in every module after load_state/set_sim, so a module can drop or rebuild its queue on resync; controls.lua does not yet use it.
Owner decision (user): choose the most efficient solution; a sim-side queue is accepted, including a save format and hash change. Keep determinism for everything else.

Sim-side order queue commit: 2fe55295c80dd31af3759e64ef28f887fc43adf6 (Row: controls-queued-orders-outside-sim-state, STATE_VERSION 43->44). CI on 2fe55295c: ci run 40184805513 has 1 failing job (built page smoke, console 404, fixed upstream by a090c61d, a CI smoke fix from another lane, which exempts /__hmr); pages 4/4 success. Origin main is 3a09b2080dad6b44eb7ccdafe603daacf2d456a1 (contains 2fe55295c). Not closed: close needs a green ci on the witnessed sha; closing on a090c61d is refused by the owner.
